record_title: Weak off-diagonal necessity for monomial-curve commutators in every dimension
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Unweighted only; no claim for Bloom weights, compactness, q<p, q=infinity, or general finite-type curves. Outside the known Oikari sufficiency region, the result is only necessary. The higher-dimensional companion geometry is taken from Li--Zeng's all-dimensional theorem and its stated extension. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the principal residual risk is contemporaneous discussion of the very recent September 2026 source preprint. No independent validation is asserted.
